access_links.label: Transmission network datasets on the openmod wiki

description: National Grid ETYS 2014 Model is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Transmission network datasets > Europe", published or maintained by www2.nationalgrid.com (publisher inferred from the link). Coverage: Great Britain. The openmod wiki page "Transmission network datasets" lists it under "Europe". It contains topology, impedances, loads, generators, about 365 buses or substations, 316 lines. The table gives 2014 as the represented year. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unclear (as given on the wiki page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity transmission network inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
